truths.truth: With stdin closed, install exits 0, asks nothing, and leaves the same settings.json, stable-path binary and claude call log as a run with a terminal attached
truths.evidence: install::run never reads stdin (crates/terminus/src/cmd/install/mod.rs:100-219; confirm at :421 has no install caller). Test install_reads_nothing_from_stdin (crates/terminus/tests/install.rs:969) passes. Spot-check: the built binary run once with stdin at /dev/null and once under a pty from script(1) (stdin confirmed a tty), both against a fake claude in scratch fixtures: both exit 0, settings.json and claude.log identical modulo the fixture root, binaries byte-identical (cmp), whole output identical, no line ending in '?' and no [Y/n].

install::parse sends any argument to crate::unexpected as Failure::Misuse (crates/terminus/src/cmd/install/mod.rs:93-98, main.rs:161). Test install_takes_no_yes_flag (tests/install.rs:928) passes for --yes and -y: exit 2, nothing placed, settings.json unchanged, no claude call.

truths.truth: With a fake claude that writes nothing, ~/.claude.json is byte-identical after install, a rerun and uninstall
truths.evidence: No write path targets .claude.json: install's register only calls Document::read (mod.rs:260-295); uninstall's unregister only reads and computes backup_path (uninstall.rs:300-345); the only Document::apply/overwrite/backup callers are on settings.json (mod.rs:126,129; uninstall.rs:142,201). Tests pass: install_then_uninstall_leaves_both_files_exactly_as_they_were (tests/uninstall.rs:301, byte comparison after install, rerun, uninstall) and two_installs_leave_claude_json_alone_and_each_asks_claude_for_the_add (tests/install.rs:722). Spot-check: .claude.json byte-identical after a real install run in a scratch fixture.

truths.truth: Install runs claude mcp add-json --scope user terminus with command = stable path and args ["mcp"], and every claude process gets CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1
truths.evidence: Add call at crates/terminus/src/cmd/install/mod.rs:285; entry built by targets::mcp_entry (targets.rs:214-228); runner sets the variable on every spawn (claude.rs:89); doctor's claude --version sets it (doctor.rs:1179). Tests pass: two_installs_leave_claude_json_alone_and_each_asks_claude_for_the_add (added_entry asserts the five args, traffic=1, and assert_current checks type/command/args), every_claude_gets_the_traffic_variable (claude.rs:217), doctors_claude_version_runs_with_nonessential_traffic_off (tests/doctor.rs:567), and the remove calls in a_stale_mcp_registration_is_removed_and_added_again and only_the_terminus_key_leaves_mcp_servers assert traffic=1. Spot-check log: traffic=1, mcp add-json --scope user terminus {"type":"stdio","command":"<fixture>/bin/terminus","args":["mcp"]}.

truths.truth: With the entry already correct in ~/.claude.json, a rerun logs no claude call
truths.evidence: register returns Registered::Current before any claude::run when targets::mcp_entry_is_current holds (mod.rs:269-271; targets.rs:200-206). Tests pass: a_current_mcp_registration_runs_no_claude (tests/install.rs:784) asserts an empty call log, and only_the_terminus_key_leaves_mcp_servers (tests/uninstall.rs:343) asserts install ran no claude for a current entry.

truths.truth: A wrong-shaped user entry is removed with mcp remove --scope user terminus and then added
truths.evidence: mod.rs:275-283 runs the remove when an entry is found and not current, then the add at :285; a failed remove stops the add. Test a_stale_mcp_registration_is_removed_and_added_again (tests/install.rs:752) passes: calls[0] is REMOVE with traffic=1, calls[1] is the add with a current entry that keeps the user's env key, .claude.json unchanged.

truths.truth: With no claude on PATH, install still places the binary and merges the hooks, prints that it is incomplete with the exact claude mcp add-json command, and exits non-zero
truths.evidence: Runner returns NotOnPath (claude.rs:73-76); install places binary and hooks before register (mod.rs:121-131), prints 'install incomplete' and 'to finish, run <command>' (mod.rs:138,166-173), exits through Failure::Silent (mod.rs:212-218). Command quoting round-trips through /bin/sh in the_finishing_command_quotes_the_entry_for_a_shell (targets.rs:460). Test without_claude_on_path_the_install_is_incomplete (tests/install.rs:838) passes: exit 1, binary present, 4 hook entries, 'incomplete', the add-json line, 'not on PATH', backfill line, .claude.json unchanged.

truths.truth: With a fake claude that exits 1, install still places the binary and merges the hooks, prints that it is incomplete with the exact command, and exits non-zero
truths.evidence: Runner reports the first stderr line as Outcome::Failed (claude.rs:129-141), register turns it into Incomplete (mod.rs:285-293). Test a_claude_that_fails_leaves_the_install_incomplete_with_its_first_line (tests/install.rs:850) passes: exit 1, binary and 4 hooks in place, the add-json line, the mcp line ending '(not registered: first)', no 'second' line. an_unreadable_claude_json_leaves_the_install_incomplete_and_runs_no_claude (tests/install.rs:871) also passes.

truths.truth: Install merges the hook entries into settings.json with one backup, and a rerun leaves settings.json byte-identical with no new backup
truths.evidence: Backup and write only when the hooks are pending (mod.rs:118,125-130); Document::backup never refreshes an existing backup (json_file.rs:466-489). Test two_installs_leave_one_hook_entry_per_event_and_change_nothing_else (tests/install.rs:566) passes: two runs, 4 entries, user's group intact, key order unchanged, exactly one backup holding the pre-install bytes, second run byte-identical. Spot-check: the only files a fresh install created or changed were bin/terminus, settings.json and settings.json.terminus-backup.

truths.truth: The receipt lists every file changed, the backfill estimate, terminus status as the place to watch, the current cleanupPeriodDays, the line saying older transcripts are already gone, and the line that raises it
truths.evidence: Receipt printed at mod.rs:135-208 (binary, settings.json, .claude.json, backups, data directory), advise at mod.rs:362-398 (value at every setting, 'already gone', 'set "cleanupPeriodDays": 3650 in <path>'), start_backfill at mod.rs:313-351 (estimate plus terminus status). Tests pass: install_reports_the_two_settings_it_never_changes (tests/install.rs:1059, values 7, 3650 and unset) and the_receipt_carries_the_backfill_estimate (tests/install.rs:1124). Spot-check output named every file the run changed (bin/terminus, settings.json, its backup) plus .claude.json, and showed 'cleanupPeriodDays is 7.', 'older than 7 days are already gone', the raise line, '0 transcript(s), 0 B not yet archived' and 'terminus status'.

truths.truth: After install, cleanupPeriodDays and autoCompactEnabled hold the values they had before
truths.evidence: No code in crates/terminus/src writes either key: the only references are reads and printed text (install/mod.rs:368-395, doctor.rs:946-1045), and the Json::number writer was removed. install_reports_the_two_settings_it_never_changes (tests/install.rs:1117-1118) passes, asserting both values unchanged for three seeds. Spot-check settings.json after install: cleanupPeriodDays 7, autoCompactEnabled true, as seeded.

gaps.name: Uninstall prints the old .claude.json backup path even when .claude.json cannot be parsed
gaps.reason: behavior wrong - D-15 says uninstall prints the path of an existing .claude.json.terminus-backup with no condition, but the print sits after an early return taken when .claude.json does not parse
gaps.evidence: crates/terminus/src/cmd/uninstall.rs:304-309 returns false on a Document::read failure before the backup check at :334-343. Observed in a scratch fixture (.claude.json = '{', old backup present): output says 'left alone: ... is not valid JSON ... terminus will not overwrite a settings file it cannot read' and never names the backup, which stays in place unrestored. A broken live file is the case where the user most needs to know the old copy exists.
gaps.missing: In unregister, compute the backup path from the .claude.json path itself (or move the backup report ahead of the early return) so the path is printed whether or not the file parses, and add a test with an unparseable .claude.json and an old backup asserting the path is printed and the backup bytes are unchanged.
